usage: Declarative protocol. Generate an actual verified model.json with prepare_policy; this file alone does not launch anything.

observations.history_source_frame_rule: floor(2.5*k), k=0,1,... on the25Hz action clock
observations.past_frames: Strictly before the current frame, same episode, uniformly selected from every captured source point over the complete prefix; preserve first/last when subsampling.
observations.image_order: Selected past MAIN images in time order, then current MAIN/left-wrist/right-wrist.

executed_history.commit: Only after validated actual-execution ACK, including episode, exact ID/text/prompt/commands, action range and physics clock.

timeouts.timed_out_HTTP_child: Kill and reap the exact request child before returning or retrying; key enters only private stdin.
timeouts.retry_scope: Only preserved transport/transient429/5xx and empty public-content length errors; body remains identical.

policy.inputs: Current3RGB, State14 and composed prompt only; selector history is not sent to pi0.5.
policy.success_and_termination: Original SDK rules, including partial final execution ACK when native termination occurs.

deployment_limits: External checkpoint, original training source, SDK/assets, compatible policy/simulator environments and authorized API access are required.
Actual full-file checkpoint binding and private SDK/source/layout checks are mandatory.
GPU ownership and native renderer/environment admission are external prerequisites; this code does not reserve resources.
CPU fixtures do not establish actual API/GPU/native acceptance or policy success.
No actual evaluation has been launched by this implementation PR.
